to hold on, to grab onto

notes:
{捕|つか}まる has two main meanings: 'to be caught/arrested' and 'to hold onto something.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {捕|つか}まえる (transitive, to catch)

SENSE 1 - Be caught:
- {犯人|はんにん}が{捕|つか}まる: a criminal is caught
- {警察|けいさつ}に{捕|つか}まる: to be caught by police
- タクシーが{捕|つか}まらない: can't catch a taxi

SENSE 2 - Hold onto:
- {手|て}すりに{捕|つか}まる: to hold onto the handrail
- {吊|つ}り{革|かわ}に{捕|つか}まる: to hold onto the strap (on train)

KANJI NOTE:
{捕|つか}まる uses {捕|ほ} (capture). The related verb {掴|つか}む (to grab) uses different kanji.
